blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Buckingham Heights address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. Buckingham Elementary (K–7), 6066 Buckingham Ave, sits inside the sub-area, and Burnaby Central Secondary (8–12), 6011 Deer Lake Parkway, and Moscrop Secondary (8–12), 4433 Moscrop St, are the nearest secondaries on the Province's list; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: What is at the sub-area's doorstep?
faq.a: Deer Lake Park — the City's cultural centre, with the Shadbolt Centre for the Arts, Burnaby Art Gallery, Burnaby Village Museum and the lake trails, open dawn to dusk year-round at 6450 Deer Lake Ave; note the boat-launch boardwalk section is closed for replacement until winter 2027.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Buckingham Heights?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Buckingham Heights is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
